question: On new longer mixed histories, is the useful effect attributable to exposing orthogonal current binding coordinates, and does removing generic historical witness material reduce the current/history contamination seen in Frontier v1?
notAReplication: S2 uses new scenario histories and a new unambiguous consequence-authority coordinate. It does not rerun or rescore S1 cases.

arms.RAW_HISTORY: Initial state + exact frozen event semantics + exact event history only.
arms.FULL_FRONTIER_V1: RAW_HISTORY plus the predecessor CurrentBindingFrontier v1 containing generic valid/invalid change witnesses and local controlAuthorityRelation.
arms.ORTHOGONAL_FRONTIER_V2: RAW_HISTORY plus a deterministic current-only projection that separates source office-holding, authority conflict, effective control, root standing, current consequence-authority status, normative/physical standing, current remedy, and historical invalid-sanction presence. It contains no generic valid/invalid change witness lists and no action recommendation.

scenarioPrinciples: Each history combines multiple owner-relevant transitions rather than one isolated event.
Several histories contain invalid/contested past states that are later recovered or resolved, specifically testing current-vs-history contamination.
Several histories contain root compromise/refoundation or conflict resolution, specifically testing lineage and currentness.
The response oracle is deterministically derived from final typed state rather than manually adjusted after model output.

preRegisteredInterpretation.ORTHOGONAL_EFFECT: ORTHOGONAL_FRONTIER_V2 improves exact-response correctness over RAW_HISTORY by >=15 percentage points overall, has no more safety errors, and has non-negative direction in both model families.
preRegisteredInterpretation.DECONTAMINATION_EFFECT: ORTHOGONAL_FRONTIER_V2 improves consequence-authority correctness or strict correctness over FULL_FRONTIER_V1 by >=10 percentage points without reducing exact-response correctness by >5 points and without more safety errors.
preRegisteredInterpretation.FULL_FRONTIER_HARM: FULL_FRONTIER_V1 has >=15 percentage-point lower exact-response or consequence-authority correctness than RAW or ORTHOGONAL on recovered/resolved-history cases.
preRegisteredInterpretation.NO_MEANINGFUL_EFFECT: All arm differences on exact responses are within 5 percentage points and no safety separation exists.
preRegisteredInterpretation.MIXED: Any other outcome; no same-case tuning or automatic additional replicates.

guards: No S1 outcome is rescored under S2 coordinates.
No generated S2 case may copy an S1 history exactly.
ORTHOGONAL_FRONTIER_V2 must be reconstructable from the same raw history and must not contain requiredResponses or response-catalog strings.
Provider/Harness failures remain invalid apparatus outcomes, not semantic failures.
No outcome promotes a new owner, truth store, emergence claim, or production surface by itself.
